slot: Your question, plus the daily report
summary: The S&P 500 fell 0.45% to 7,585.73 today, pulled down by two forces hitting at once: the 10-year Treasury yield, which is the interest rate the US government pays to borrow money for ten years, touched 5.00%, a level not seen since 2023, and oil jumped 4.43% partly due to outages at a Saudi pipeline. Higher borrowing costs make stocks less attractive compared to bonds, so money rotates out. Tomorrow is the big one: the Federal Reserve is expected to raise interest rates, with traders pricing in a greater than 92% chance of a hike. Bitcoin fell 2.73% after the Senate blocked the Clarity Act, a bill that would have given crypto clearer legal rules.
